notes.title: Progress of RealLife
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

RealLife is progressing well. You may have noticed that the Discord server was deleted, but don’t worry—the project is still ongoing. I’ll share a new Discord link soon.

I deleted the Discord server because I think it’s better to release the game before reopening it.

I’m considering whether to share new screenshots of the game.

The most complex systems are now completed.

I’ll need to redo the map, as everything crashed when I upgraded to a new version.

I also need to review the bus system, as it’s currently full of errors.

The most satisfying part is that the first version of the banking system is fully completed.

The characters in RealLife will be MetaHumans (characters developed by Unreal Engine).

The server system is working (there will be no private servers at the game’s launch).

You’ll have a tutorial to learn the basic features at the start.

I won’t reveal more about the upcoming features—I’ll keep them as a surprise for you.

Attention, beta testers: a major update is coming, so stay alert for update event announcements!

That’s the latest news on RealLife’s progress. I know it’s taking time, but I’d rather deliver a decent game than a rushed one full of bugs.

Thank you for your support.

Sincerely,
Valak, Director of Systheme and the RealLife project
